signature: web boot · 1 entry did not activate: dsh-vantage: failed
message: web boot: 1 entry did not activate (dsh-vantage: failed). The desktop shell reported the failure through DESKTOP_IPC.bootFailed -> reportFatal(err, "web-boot"), so the whole renderer boot was reported as failed while the host process stayed alive. Root cause per the plugin's own fix commit 33fb8b7: the client entry registered its overview view outside the slot graph, so activation failed.

culprit.name: dsh-vantage
culprit.evidence: package.json dsh.client.inject + client.js view registration (fixed in 33fb8b7 'register the overview view through the slot graph so the client entry activates')
